findings.conclusion: The successful archive schema and fields match the actual v3 verifier source: five stage names, ordinary_five_stages_passed, validation_schema, originals, all_input_bindings, native_streams, tests, feature before/after and ordinary release identities. The original stdout sequence is derived from actual stage rows and is compared to the retained native bytes; the verifier native's single output record must identify the retained postflight bytes.

Ordinary report input/tested/after/source-map equals the original qualified 222-map and launch proof, with 19 original harnesses. The original eight-stage qualification report is retained separately. Each of the five selected stage commands equals its corresponding qualification command with only --all-features removed and the preserved output prefix changed. Stage return codes, original elapsed values and full stdout/stderr hashes are matched.

Counts come from actual ordinary summary/audit rather than feature counts. The five original audit input files are hashed against the original audit. Every compressed stdout/stderr log is matched to its original gzip SHA through commands.jsonl and the complete original audit membership. Gzip case logs are neither decompressed nor re-audited; no test binary or target is run.

Six release identities from the original postflight are reconciled with the feature/ordinary reports; ELF bodies are excluded. Original before/after test ELF custody is retained, with explicit retained_test_elves_rehashed_by_postflight=false and test_binary_hashes_recomputed=false. The collector does not re-read potentially large debug/test binaries or claim a fresh release-body hash.

Selected bound originals are byte-matched. Other Q/CI/source references remain explicit external original identities, with external_originals_rehashed_by_archive=false. The completed Q tar and exact-CI original-file catalog are accurately described as different artifact kinds and are not fetched or executed by this collector.

Original 32MiB selected/combined-output, 8MiB per-file, 2MiB manifest and 8192-member bounds remain. Output names are fresh ordinary-evidence-02-01.* with O_EXCL/NOFOLLOW and fsync. Verification is bounded in memory and extracts zero paths. The sealer only parses source AST and original JSON/bytes, injects the single ACTUAL assignment and creates a fresh output directory.
